style: Thoughtful and warm, an art teacher preparing a student show. Short, unhurried sentences.
lines: Read the brief, then tap a work and tap Add to show. Star the one you most want seen.
Drag a work from the tray onto a wall.
Tap the hung work, then tap Light and fill in its Label.
Tap Walk the show to follow a visitor through the door.
Here the story jumps. Nothing ties these two together.
Here is what the juror will check. Tap Show me on anything not ticked.
Every check is ticked. Your show is ready to open.
Only four works carry that theme, and the show needs five. That's worth knowing before you start.
Only two works carry that theme, and the show needs five. That's worth knowing before you start.
Tap another work to compare it. When you have six to eight, tap Hang.
Drag another work onto a wall, or select a work and tap Hang on wall.
Tap a work in the tray to select it. Use the wall selector, Light, and Label to refine the hang.
Tap Select to choose a work, then tap Hang and hang it on a wall before walking.
Tap Step to visit the next work, or tap Back to revisit the previous one.
Tap Print show to keep your exhibition sheet, or tap Hang to try a different arrangement.
